required_patterns.jwt-authentication: All API authentication must use JWT Bearer tokens via Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer
required_patterns.asp-net-identity: User management must use ASP.NET Core Identity with ApplicationUser and ApplicationRole entities
required_patterns.authorize-attribute: Protected endpoints must use [Authorize] attribute on controllers or actions
required_patterns.claims-based-auth: User identity accessed via ClaimsPrincipal and ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier

architectural_constraints.jwt-token-generation: JWT tokens generated by IJwtService implementation in Infrastructure layer
architectural_constraints.password-hashing: Password hashing handled by ASP.NET Core Identity UserManager
architectural_constraints.token-storage: Frontend stores JWT tokens in localStorage
architectural_constraints.token-transmission: Tokens sent via Authorization header using Bearer scheme
architectural_constraints.user-isolation: All user data must be filtered by ApplicationUserId foreign key

required_patterns.repository-pattern: All database access goes through repository interfaces defined in Domain layer
required_patterns.entity-framework-core: Use Entity Framework Core 9.0 with DbContext for all data operations
required_patterns.async-operations: All database operations must be asynchronous (async/await)
required_patterns.guid-primary-keys: All entities use Guid for primary keys

architectural_constraints.dbcontext-registration: AppDbContext registered as scoped service in DI container
architectural_constraints.sql-server: SQL Server is the only supported database provider
architectural_constraints.migrations: Database schema changes via Entity Framework migrations
architectural_constraints.no-direct-dbcontext: Controllers/Application services must use repositories, not AppDbContext directly

required_patterns.domain-layer: Core business entities, enums, and repository interfaces in PrayerTasker.Domain
required_patterns.application-layer: DTOs, service interfaces, and business logic in PrayerTasker.Application
required_patterns.infrastructure-layer: External concerns (DB, HTTP clients, JWT) in PrayerTasker.Infrastructure
required_patterns.presentation-layer: API controllers and web config in PrayerTasker.Api

architectural_constraints.dependency-direction: Dependencies flow inward: Api → Application → Domain ← Infrastructure
architectural_constraints.domain-independence: Domain layer has no external dependencies except System libraries
architectural_constraints.interface-segregation: Application layer defines interfaces; Infrastructure implements them
architectural_constraints.dto-mapping: AutoMapper used for Entity ↔ DTO transformations in Application layer
architectural_constraints.service-container-pattern: Each layer has DI/ServiceContainer.cs for registering dependencies

required_patterns.restful-conventions: Follow REST principles with resource-based URLs
required_patterns.http-verbs: Use appropriate HTTP verbs: GET (read), POST (create), PUT (update), PATCH (partial update), DELETE (remove)
required_patterns.model-validation: Validate DTOs using [Required], [MaxLength] attributes and ModelState.IsValid
required_patterns.status-codes: Return appropriate HTTP status codes (200 OK, 201 Created, 400 BadRequest, 401 Unauthorized, 404 NotFound)

architectural_constraints.controller-base: All API controllers inherit from ControllerBase (not Controller)
architectural_constraints.cors-configuration: CORS enabled for Angular (port 4200) and React (port 3000)
architectural_constraints.primary-constructor: Controllers use C# 12 primary constructor syntax for dependency injection
architectural_constraints.async-actions: All controller actions must be async and return Task<IActionResult>

required_patterns.standalone-components: All Angular components use standalone: true (no NgModules)
required_patterns.signal-based-state: Component state managed using Angular signals and computed signals
required_patterns.reactive-forms: Forms built using Angular Reactive Forms with FormBuilder
required_patterns.component-lifecycle: Implement OnInit for initialization, OnDestroy for cleanup

architectural_constraints.component-imports: Components explicitly import CommonModule, services, and child components
architectural_constraints.services-injection: Services injected via constructor with inject() function or constructor DI
architectural_constraints.css-isolation: Component styles scoped to component (not global)
architectural_constraints.cdk-usage: Use Angular CDK for complex UI behaviors (e.g., DragDropModule for drag-and-drop)

required_patterns.service-based-state: State managed in Angular services using RxJS BehaviorSubject
required_patterns.reactive-patterns: Use RxJS operators for async data streams
required_patterns.local-storage: Persist authentication tokens and user preferences in localStorage
required_patterns.signal-reactivity: Use Angular signals for reactive component state

architectural_constraints.no-global-state-library: No NgRx or external state management libraries
architectural_constraints.service-singletons: Services provided in root (providedIn: 'root') for singleton behavior
architectural_constraints.subject-encapsulation: BehaviorSubjects kept private; expose Observable via asObservable()
architectural_constraints.subscription-cleanup: Unsubscribe from observables in OnDestroy to prevent memory leaks

required_patterns.file-based-routes: Routes defined in app.routes.ts as Routes array
required_patterns.route-guards: Protected routes use canActivate guards (e.g., authGuard)
required_patterns.programmatic-navigation: Use Router.navigate() for navigation in components

architectural_constraints.guard-functions: Route guards implemented as functional guards (not class-based)
architectural_constraints.route-params: Access route parameters via ActivatedRoute service
architectural_constraints.redirect-unauthenticated: Auth guard redirects to /login if user not authenticated

required_patterns.httpclient-service: HTTP requests made via Angular HttpClient in services
required_patterns.error-handling: Handle HTTP errors with catchError operator or try-catch

architectural_constraints.http-interceptors: JWT token automatically added via authInterceptor
architectural_constraints.base-url-environment: API base URL configured in environment.ts/environment.development.ts
architectural_constraints.credentials-included: HTTP requests include credentials for CORS
architectural_constraints.service-encapsulation: API calls encapsulated in service methods (not in components)

required_patterns.built-in-di: Use ASP.NET Core built-in DI container (not third-party containers)
required_patterns.interface-based-registration: Register services via interfaces, not concrete types
required_patterns.service-lifetimes: Choose appropriate lifetimes: Transient, Scoped, Singleton

architectural_constraints.scoped-repositories: Repositories registered as Scoped (per HTTP request)
architectural_constraints.service-containers: Each layer defines extension methods (e.g., AddApplicationServices, AddInfrastructureServices)

required_patterns.hangfire-integration: Background jobs managed via Hangfire library
required_patterns.sql-storage: Hangfire uses SQL Server for job storage and state

architectural_constraints.job-registration: Jobs registered in Program.cs or dedicated service
architectural_constraints.hangfire-server: HangfireServer middleware enabled in DI container

required_patterns.httpclient-factory: Use IHttpClientFactory or AddHttpClient for external API calls
required_patterns.dto-deserialization: Deserialize API responses to typed response DTOs
required_patterns.caching-layer: Cache external API responses in database to reduce redundant calls

architectural_constraints.aladhan-api: Prayer times fetched from AlAdhan API (https://api.aladhan.com/v1)
architectural_constraints.prayer-time-caching: Cache prayer times in DailyUserPrayerTime table by date, method, userId
architectural_constraints.timeout-handling: TODO: Implement timeout for external HTTP calls
architectural_constraints.error-wrapping: Wrap external API errors in custom exceptions (e.g., PrayerTimeServiceException)

required_patterns.prayer-time-slots: Tasks categorized by PrayerTimeSlot enum (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha)
required_patterns.entity-validation: Domain entities use Data Annotations for validation ([Required], [MaxLength])
required_patterns.date-based-queries: Prayer times and tasks queried by DateTime Date property
required_patterns.user-ownership: All user-specific entities linked via ApplicationUserId foreign key

architectural_constraints.prayer-time-immutability: Prayer times are calculation-based, not user-editable
architectural_constraints.task-naming: TODO: Rename Taask entity to TaskEntity to avoid System.Threading.Tasks.Task conflict
architectural_constraints.calculation-methods: Prayer calculation method stored as integer (references AlAdhan API methods)
architectural_constraints.hijri-calendar: Frontend uses moment-hijri for Islamic calendar support

required_patterns.jasmine-karma: Frontend tests use Jasmine framework with Karma test runner

architectural_constraints.backend-testing: TODO: Backend unit/integration tests not yet implemented

required_patterns.ngx-translate: Use ngx-translate library for i18n support
required_patterns.translation-files: Translation keys stored in JSON files (not yet implemented)

architectural_constraints.hijri-calendar-support: moment-hijri integrated for Islamic calendar display
architectural_constraints.rtl-support: TODO: Right-to-left language support for Arabic
